'''Drovis Cave''' or '''Drovis Cavern''' was a cave located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] the cave was used by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] affiliated with [[House Rist]] as their base of operations. The cave was infiltrated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual, who confronted [[Vessex Ulgo]].
